context: Hina-young and Riku-teen practice for a school play together.
purpose: Two teens helping each other rehearse lines warmly.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: This role is really hard, isn't it…
lines.style: Soft opening, a little hesitant. Thinking out loud rather than complaining. Warm but slightly worried. Trails off like she's hoping for reassurance.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.en: Want to run through the script one more time?
lines.style: Gentle, practical offer. No pressure in the voice — just quietly present. A beat of pause before speaking, like he's reading her mood first.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Small, relieved. Immediate and grateful without overdoing it. The exhale of someone who needed to be asked.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.en: The performance is going to be amazing.
lines.style: Quiet conviction underneath. Not hyping her up — genuinely believes it. Warm, steady eye contact in the voice. A small smile around the words.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I'm nervous, but I'll do my best.
lines.style: Soft determination. Acknowledges the fear without dwelling in it. Slight lift at the end — resolution settling in. Breath stays steady and grounded.
